# Ollvy - Complete Reference

> Ollvy is India's modern company registration and compliance platform. We help entrepreneurs register businesses, obtain necessary licenses, and stay compliant with Indian regulations - all online, with transparent pricing and real-time tracking.

## About Ollvy

Ollvy simplifies business registration and compliance in India. Founded to make entrepreneurship accessible, we handle the paperwork so founders can focus on building their businesses.

### What We Do
- **Company Registration**: Private Limited, LLP, Partnership, Sole Proprietorship
- **Tax Registration & Filing**: GST, Income Tax, TDS compliance
- **Business Licenses**: FSSAI, Trademark, MSME, Shop & Establishment
- **Ongoing Compliance**: Annual filings, Director KYC, statutory returns

### Why Ollvy
- Transparent pricing with no hidden fees
- Real-time order tracking and updates
- Backed by practicing CAs and CS professionals
- End-to-end digital process
- Expert support throughout

### Contact
- Website: https://www.ollvy.com
- Email: team@ollvy.com

## Services - Complete List

### Company Registration

#### Private Limited Company Registration
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/services/pvt-ltd-incorporation
- Description: Register a Private Limited Company with MCA. Includes DSC for directors, DIN application, name approval, incorporation certificate, PAN & TAN. Ideal for startups seeking investment.
- Timeline: 7-10 working days
- Mandatory for: Businesses seeking venture funding, foreign investment, or planning for scale

#### LLP Registration
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/services/llp-incorporation
- Description: Register a Limited Liability Partnership. Combines partnership flexibility with limited liability protection. Includes DPIN, LLP Agreement filing, incorporation certificate.
- Timeline: 7-10 working days
- Mandatory for: Professional services firms, consultancies, small businesses wanting limited liability

#### Company Name Change
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/services/company-name-change
- Description: Change your company's registered name with MCA. Includes name availability check, board resolution, shareholder approval, and new incorporation certificate.
- Timeline: 15-20 working days

---

### Tax Registration

#### GST Registration
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/services/gst-registration
- Description: Get your GSTIN (Goods and Services Tax Identification Number). Required for businesses with turnover above Rs. 40 lakh (goods) or Rs. 20 lakh (services), or for interstate sales.
- Timeline: 3-7 working days
- Mandatory for: Businesses above turnover threshold, e-commerce sellers, interstate suppliers

#### GST Cancellation
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/services/gst-cancellation
- Description: Voluntary cancellation of GST registration when business closes or turnover falls below threshold. Includes final return filing.
- Timeline: 15-30 working days

#### GST Revocation
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/services/gst-revocation
- Description: Revoke a cancelled GST registration. Must be filed within 30 days of cancellation order (extendable to 90 days with appeal).
- Timeline: 15-30 working days

---

### Tax Filing - Recurring Compliance

#### Business ITR Filing
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/services/business-itr
- Description: Income tax return filing for companies and LLPs. Includes ITR-6 for companies, ITR-5 for LLPs, computation of income, tax audit if required.
- Timeline: 3-7 working days
- Due Date: September 30 for audit cases, July 31 for non-audit

#### GST Monthly Filing
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/services/gst-monthly
- Description: Monthly GST compliance - GSTR-1 (outward supplies) by 11th, GSTR-3B (summary return) by 20th. Includes reconciliation and ITC matching.
- Frequency: Monthly retainer
- Mandatory for: All GST registered businesses

#### TDS Monthly Compliance
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/services/tds-monthly-compliance
- Description: TDS deduction, payment by 7th, and quarterly return filing. Covers salary TDS, contractor TDS, professional fees TDS.
- Frequency: Monthly retainer
- Mandatory for: Companies and businesses making specified payments

### Company Compliance - Annual Filings

#### MCA Annual Filing
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/services/mca-annual-filing
- Description: Mandatory annual filings for companies - AOC-4 (financial statements) and MGT-7 (annual return). Due within 60 days of AGM.
- Timeline: 3-5 working days
- Mandatory for: All registered companies
- Penalty: Rs. 100 per day per form for late filing

#### DIN Reactivation
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/services/din-reactivation
- Description: Reactivate a DIN deactivated due to non-filing of DIR-3 KYC. Includes filing pending KYC and reactivation application.
- Timeline: 5-7 working days

## Guides - Educational Content

### Business Setup Guides

#### Do I Need GST Registration?
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/do-i-need-gst-registration
- Category: Tax
- Description: Interactive eligibility checker for GST registration. Covers turnover thresholds (Rs. 40L goods, Rs. 20L services), mandatory registration cases (e-commerce, interstate), voluntary registration benefits.
- Key Points: E-commerce sellers must register from day 1. Interstate sales require registration regardless of turnover. Service providers have lower threshold than goods sellers.

#### Pvt Ltd vs LLP - Which Should You Choose?
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/pvt-ltd-vs-llp
- Category: Incorporation
- Description: Comprehensive comparison of Private Limited Company vs LLP. Covers compliance burden, taxation, foreign investment rules, funding implications.
- Key Points: Pvt Ltd better for VC funding. LLP has lower compliance. Both offer limited liability. Pvt Ltd can have ESOPs, LLP cannot.

#### Do I Need to File ITR?
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/do-i-need-to-file-itr
- Category: Tax
- Description: Guide to mandatory ITR filing rules. Covers income thresholds, foreign assets, high-value transactions that trigger mandatory filing.
- Key Points: Income above Rs. 2.5L requires ITR. Foreign assets require ITR regardless of income. High-value transactions (Rs. 1Cr+ deposits) trigger mandatory filing.

#### Which ITR Form Should I File?
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/which-itr-form-should-i-use
- Category: Tax
- Description: Guide to choosing correct ITR form - ITR-1 to ITR-7. Based on income sources, business type, and entity type.

#### Is MSME/Udyam Registration Worth It?
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/is-msme-registration-worth-it
- Category: Registration
- Description: Benefits and eligibility for MSME registration. Covers credit guarantee scheme, interest subvention, government tender preference.
- Key Points: Free registration. Priority sector lending. 45-day payment mandate for government contracts. Collateral-free loans up to Rs. 2 crore.

#### DPIIT Startup Recognition
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/should-i-get-dpiit-startup-recognition
- Category: Startup
- Description: Guide to Startup India recognition. Covers eligibility criteria, tax benefits (Section 80-IAC), angel tax exemption, easier public procurement.
- Key Points: Company/LLP less than 10 years old. Turnover below Rs. 100 crore. Working on innovation. Get 3-year tax holiday, angel tax exemption.

### Employer Compliance Guides

#### PF Registration
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/when-does-pf-registration-become-mandatory
- Category: Payroll
- Description: Provident Fund registration and compliance guide. When mandatory, how to register, monthly compliance, penalties.
- Key Points: Mandatory if 20+ employees. 12% employer contribution. Monthly payment by 15th. Major penalties for non-compliance.

#### ESI Registration
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/when-does-esi-registration-become-mandatory
- Category: Payroll
- Description: ESIC registration and compliance. Covers threshold, contribution rates, hospital benefits, maternity benefits.
- Key Points: Mandatory if 10+ employees and wages up to Rs. 21,000/month. 0.75% employee + 3.25% employer contribution.

#### Professional Tax
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/do-i-need-professional-tax-registration
- Category: Tax
- Description: State-wise professional tax guide. Covers registration, slabs, payment, and compliance by state.
- Key Points: State-specific tax on employment. Maximum Rs. 2,500/year. Employer must deduct and deposit.

#### Shop & Establishment Registration
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/do-i-need-shop-establishment-registration
- Category: Licensing
- Description: Shop & Establishment Act compliance. State-wise requirements, registration process, renewal.
- Key Points: Mandatory for all commercial establishments. Regulates working hours, holidays, employment conditions.

#### Do I Need Trademark Registration?
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/do-i-need-trademark-registration
- Category: Registration
- Description: Guide to when trademark registration makes sense. Covers TM vs R, classes, priority dates, and opposition process.
- Key Points: File early - first-to-file system. TM symbol available immediately. R symbol after registration (12-18 months). 10-year validity.

#### FSSAI License Requirements
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/do-i-need-fssai-license
- Category: Licensing
- Description: Complete guide to FSSAI licensing. Basic vs State vs Central license, eligibility, documents, renewal.
- Key Points: Basic for turnover under Rs. 12L. State for Rs. 12L-20Cr. Central for Rs. 20Cr+.

## Income-tax Act 2025 Transition (New Tax Law, Effective April 1, 2026)

India replaced the Income-tax Act, 1961 with the Income-tax Act, 2025 from April 1, 2026. Section numbers, TDS provisions, and form numbers all changed. AY 2026-27 and earlier years stay under the 1961 Act; tax year 2026-27 onward uses the new Act.

#### Old vs New Section Mapping (1961 Act to 2025 Act)
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/income-tax-act-2025-section-mapping
- Category: Tax
- Description: Section finder mapping the Income-tax Act 1961 to the Income-tax Act 2025. Returns 139 to 263, intimation 143(1) to 270(1), scrutiny 143(2) to 270(2), inquiry 142(1) to 268(1), reopening 147/148/148A to 279/280/281, demand 156 to 289, advance tax 207-211 to 403-408, interest 234B/234C to 424/425, tax audit 44AB to 63, TDS to 392/393/394.
- Key Points: Savings clause Section 536(2)(c) keeps pre-April-2026 proceedings under the 1961 Act. Which Act applies depends on when the notice was issued and which year it covers.

#### New TDS Sections and Forms FY 2026-27
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/new-tds-sections-fy2026-27
- Category: TDS Filing
- Description: The 194 series is abolished. Salary TDS is Section 392, all non-salary TDS is Section 393, TCS is Section 394. Challans use numeric payment codes 1001-1092 (194C is now code 1017). Form 24Q became Form 138, 26Q became 140, 27EQ became 143, 27Q became 144. Old-format uploads are rejected on TRACES.
- Key Points: Q2 FY2026-27 return due October 31, 2026. Q3 due January 31, 2027. Late fee Rs. 200/day continues to run while formats are wrong.

#### Form 141 for TDS on Property and Rent
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/form-141-tds-property-rent
- Category: TDS Filing
- Description: Unified Form 141 challan-cum-statement replaces 26QB (property purchase), 26QC (rent), 26QD and 26QE for deductions from April 1, 2026. Applies to property buyers (1% TDS on Rs. 50 lakh+) and tenants paying Rs. 50,000+/month rent.
- Key Points: Deposit within 30 days from month-end of deduction. Rs. 200/day late fee plus 1-1.5% monthly interest.

#### Form 16 is Now Form 130
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/form-16-is-now-form-130
- Category: Payroll
- Description: The salary TDS certificate for tax year 2026-27 is Form 130 (Form 16A became 131, 16B became 132, 16C became 133). Employers must issue Form 130 by June 15, 2027.
- Key Points: Employees need Form 130 to file the 2027 ITR. Per-day penalty on employers for failure to issue.

#### Section 280/281 Reopening Notice (New Act)
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/income-tax-280-281-reopening
- Category: Income Tax Notice
- Description: Reassessment under the Income-tax Act 2025: Section 280 notice and Section 281 show-cause replace 148/148A for notices issued on or after April 1, 2026. Explains which Act applies to a given notice and how to respond on the faceless portal.
- Severity: Urgent
- Deadline: As stated in the notice (typically 30 days)

#### Section 270(1) Intimation (New Act)
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/income-tax-270-intimation
- Category: Income Tax Notice
- Description: Section 270(1) intimation replaces the 143(1) intimation for returns filed under the 2025 Act. Covers adjustments, demand and refund scenarios; an intimation with demand is deemed a notice of demand under Section 289.
- Severity: Moderate
- Deadline: 30 days to respond to proposed adjustments

---

## Upcoming Compliance Deadlines and New Requirements (2026-27)

#### MCA Amnesty Scheme CCFS 2026
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/ccfs-2026
- Category: ROC Filing
- Description: Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme 2026 - one-time MCA window to clear pending AOC-4, MGT-7/7A, ADT-1 and FC forms at 10% of additional fees, dormant status at 50%, strike-off at 25%. Window ends August 31, 2026 (extended from July 15 by General Circular 03/2026).
- Key Points: After August 31, full Rs. 100/day additional fees return, plus adjudication under Section 454 and director disqualification risk under Section 164(2).

#### Belated and Revised ITR for AY 2026-27
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/belated-itr-2026
- Category: Income Tax Filing
- Description: Missed the ITR deadline? Belated return under Section 139(4) and revised return under Section 139(5) can be filed until December 31, 2026 for AY 2026-27.
- Key Points: Late fee Rs. 5,000 (Rs. 1,000 if income under Rs. 5 lakh), interest under 234A, loss carry-forward lost. After December 31, only ITR-U with 25-70% additional tax.

#### ITR-U Updated Return
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/itr-u-updated-return
- Category: Income Tax Filing
- Description: File or fix returns up to 48 months back under Section 139(8A)/140B. Additional tax: 25% within 12 months, 50% within 24, 60% within 36, 70% within 48.
- Key Points: AY 2022-23 window closes March 31, 2027. Cannot be used for loss returns or to increase refunds.

#### Foreign Assets NUDGE Notice (Schedule FA)
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/schedule-fa-foreign-assets-notice
- Category: Income Tax Notice
- Description: Income tax department SMS/email campaign on undisclosed foreign assets, driven by AEOI/CRS/FATCA data in AIS. Affects employees with foreign ESOPs/RSUs and NRI-returnees. Fix by filing a revised return with Schedule FA before December 31, 2026.
- Severity: Serious
- Deadline: December 31, 2026 (revised return window)

#### Labour Codes Compliance for Employers
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/labour-codes-compliance-2026
- Category: Payroll
- Description: The four labour codes are in force (from November 21, 2025; central rules May 8, 2026). Key changes: 50% wages definition raises PF/gratuity, mandatory appointment letters, full-and-final settlement within 2 days, single registration under the Social Security Code.
- Key Points: Penalties up to Rs. 3 lakh with imprisonment for repeat violations. April 2027 increment cycle is the first full CTC restructuring season.

#### EPF Scheme 2026
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/epf-scheme-2026
- Category: Payroll
- Description: The new EPF Scheme 2026 (notified June 29, 2026, effective July 1, 2026) replaces the 1952 scheme. Contributions computed on the Social Security Code wages definition; employer contribution above the Rs. 15,000 ceiling is explicitly voluntary; EPFO 3.0 is fully electronic.
- Key Points: Late remittance draws 12% p.a. interest (7Q) plus damages (14B).

#### PAS-6 Reconciliation Return
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/pas-6-2026
- Category: ROC Filing
- Description: Half-yearly share capital reconciliation (Rule 9B/9A) for the April-September 2026 half year, due November 29, 2026. First season where most non-small private companies are in scope after the June 30, 2025 dematerialisation mandate.
- Key Points: Section 450 penalty and inability to issue or transfer securities for defaulters.

#### GST Invoice Management System (IMS)
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/gst-invoice-management-system-ims
- Category: GST
- Description: IMS is mandatory from April 1, 2026; GSTR-3B Table 4 ITC is hard-locked from the July 2026 tax period. Accept/reject/pending workflow drives GSTR-2B; manual ITC edits in GSTR-3B are no longer possible.
- Key Points: Unactioned or rejected invoices mean denied ITC, DRC-01B exposure and 18% interest.

#### GST Appellate Tribunal (GSTAT) Appeals
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/gstat-appeal-guide
- Category: GST Notice
- Description: How to appeal to GSTAT after a first-appeal (APL-01) rejection: 3-month window from the order, Form APL-05, 10% pre-deposit to stay recovery.
- Severity: Moderate
- Deadline: 3 months from the appellate order

#### Salaried ITR 2027 (Tax Year 2026-27)
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/salaried-itr-2027
- Category: Income Tax Filing
- Description: First ITR season under the Income-tax Act 2025. Salaried deadline July 31, 2027. New forms, Form 130 instead of Form 16, "tax year" terminology.
- Key Points: Form 130 issued by June 15, 2027. Late fee up to Rs. 5,000 plus interest.

#### Business ITR 2027 (Tax Year 2026-27)
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/business-itr-2027
- Category: Income Tax Filing
- Description: Non-audit business ITR deadline is now August 31, 2027 (changed from July 31 by Budget staggering). Audit cases October 31, 2027.
- Key Points: The deadline change is widely misreported; verify against the staggered schedule.

#### LUT Renewal FY 2027-28
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/lut-renewal-2027
- Category: GST Filing
- Description: Exporters and service exporters must file a fresh Letter of Undertaking (Rule 96A, Form RFD-11) before April 1, 2027 to continue zero-rated exports without paying IGST.
- Key Points: No valid LUT means paying IGST upfront and claiming refunds later.

#### LLP Form 11 2027
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/llp-form-11-2027
- Category: ROC Filing
- Description: LLP annual return for FY 2026-27, due May 30, 2027 (Rule 25(1) LLP Rules).
- Key Points: Late filing draws multiplier-based additional fees with no cap; designated partners are liable.

#### DPT-3 2027
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/dpt-3-2027
- Category: ROC Filing
- Description: Return of deposits and outstanding loan receipts for FY 2026-27, due June 30, 2027. Covers director loans, inter-corporate loans and advances.
- Key Points: Rule 21 penalty plus Section 73/76A exposure for unreported deposits.

#### Advance Tax Q1 FY 2027-28
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/advance-tax-q1-2027
- Category: Tax
- Description: 15% of estimated tax due June 15, 2027, under Sections 404-408 of the Income-tax Act 2025 (formerly 207-211). Threshold Rs. 10,000.
- Key Points: Shortfall draws interest under Sections 423-425 (formerly 234B/234C). Presumptive taxpayers pay a single instalment by March 15.

#### IEC Annual Update 2027
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/iec-annual-update-2027
- Category: Licensing
- Description: Mandatory annual Import Export Code confirmation on the DGFT portal between April 1 and June 30, 2027, even with no changes. Free within the window.
- Key Points: Missing the window deactivates the IEC - imports, exports and bank trade transactions halt until updated.

#### FLA Return 2027
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/fla-return-2027
- Category: Compliance
- Description: RBI Foreign Liabilities and Assets return due July 15, 2027 on the FLAIR portal for any company or LLP with FDI or overseas investment on the FY 2026-27 balance sheet.
- Key Points: FEMA contravention for non-filing; late submission fee Rs. 7,500, compounding up to 300% of the amount involved.

#### FSSAI Annual Return D1 2027
- URL: https://www.ollvy.com/guides/fssai-annual-return-2027
- Category: Licensing
- Description: Form D1 annual return for FY 2026-27, due May 31, 2027 on FoSCoS. Applies to food manufacturers, importers and processors with Rs. 12 lakh+ turnover licenses.
- Key Points: Rs. 100/day penalty with no cap; blocks license renewal until filed.
